about.title: About Highlands Construction
text: Highlands Construction was founded in 2018 by Assem Mourad and Shaz Butte. Since then, Highlands has grown from a Houston commercial general contractor into a Texas-wide builder serving clients across Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, and Austin.
The company has grown, but the model has stayed personal: experienced leadership, direct communication, and founders who remain close to the work.

Assem Mourad and Shaz Butte first met in 2010 while working for the same Houston-area developer and construction firm. They built a friendship, followed different paths through the industry, and later came back together to create Highlands.
